start.terms_line: Demos follow our demo terms, and anyone can report one that breaks them.
start.claim: If you like it, enter your email address and the code we send. The app moves to a permanent address in a new or existing account. If you have more than one account, choose where it goes.

home.replay.figure.aria: A real run of this journey, sped up
home.replay.title: Your agent
home.replay.agent.1: I’ve read the CARLOS start page. Its first step is to ask what you want to build and wait for your answer before I write any code or upload anything, so I have a few questions.
home.replay.agent.q1: What do you want to make?
home.replay.agent.q2: How should it look and feel?
home.replay.agent.q3: How much have you built before?
home.replay.agent.plan: That sounds lovely. Here’s what I’d build. … Look: warm cream background, a toasted-crust brown for buttons and highlights, a soft honey-gold second colour, elegant serif headings …
home.replay.you.2: I run a little bakery called Panadería Carlos. I’d like a page where customers can pre-order bread and cakes. … I want it to feel warm and friendly. I’m not technical, so keep it simple for me.
home.replay.agent.p2: Everything works: orders save, they’re grouped by collection day with a per-day “To bake” total, and bad input is rejected. …
home.replay.agent.p3: The page looks right on both phone and desktop. …
home.replay.agent.p4: Your pre-order page for Panadería Carlos is online:
home.replay.shot.alt: The live page: a cream and brown bakery page with a bread icon, the serif heading “Panadería Carlos”, “Order today, collect mañana.” and menu cards for Pan de pueblo, Magdalenas and Ensaimada.
home.replay.caption: Excerpts from one recorded run, 12 November 2026.
home.what.heading: CARLOS is a system for building better quality, more resilient, secure web apps that deploy easily.
home.what.sub: Inspired by UNIX principles, CARLOS deploys full stack web apps as single processes rather than sprawling containerised services, using fast compiled languages. This unlocks a slew of benefits.
home.what.follow: It’s defined by an open specification.
home.what.props.title: A typical CARLOS app is
home.what.prop1.title: One file
home.what.prop1.body: Web server, database, background jobs and interface, compiled into a single binary.
home.what.prop2.title: A database per customer
home.what.prop2.body: Every customer gets their own instance and their own data. Nothing shared, nothing to leak across.
home.what.prop3.title: Asleep until needed
home.what.prop3.body: It stops when nobody is using it and wakes on the next request, with nothing lost.
home.what.prop4.title: At home anywhere
home.what.prop4.body: The same binary runs on a hosted platform, your own servers or a laptop.
home.what.prop5.title: For people and agents
home.what.prop5.body: What a person can do in the interface, an agent can do through the API or the command line.
